analysis.executive_summary: Dynamic.xyz documentation spans 2,286 crawled pages with 100% crawl coverage. Critical issues include 61 confirmed broken internal links across user-facing docs, 20.13% SEO/GEO issue rate, and only 3.37% of pages displaying last-updated metadata. API reference coverage is 66.67% across 1,534 detected API pages. Example reliability detection returned 0%, indicating a likely JS-rendering detection gap rather than true absence of code examples. Retrieval readiness scores 73.86 (moderate band), with 68.64% stale-risk flagged pages and only 11.71% of 333 key claims backed by evidence.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage at 100% (2,286 of 2,369 requested pages indexed)
High citationability at 99.87% and answerability at 98.64%, supporting AI retrieval use cases
1,534 API pages detected with 66.67% reference coverage, indicating substantial API surface documentation
90% actionability coverage shows strong task-oriented content
Zero repository navigation broken links (repo_broken_links_count: 0), isolating issues to user-facing docs only

automation_first: Deploy CI link checker to catch broken internal links before publish: 61 confirmed broken links currently degrade trust and SEO; automated pre-publish validation prevents recurrence and eliminates manual audits, saving ~4 hours/week and protecting user experience.

Automate last-updated timestamp injection from Git commit history for all 2,286 pages: only 3.37% currently show freshness metadata, leaving 2,209 pages opaque; Git-based automation delivers 100% coverage in one sprint and directly reduces the 68.64% stale-risk perception, improving RAG answer filtering and user confidence.

Implement automated SEO/GEO linting in CI for meta descriptions, title tags, and heading hierarchy: 20.13% issue rate (~460 pages) blocks organic discovery; pre-publish linting prevents new violations and provides fix suggestions, reducing manual SEO audits by ~6 hours/month and protecting search ranking.
